headline: IZMO appoints new Investor Relations agency
hook: New investor relations agency on board
summary: IZMO Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the appointment of a new Investor Relations agency. The move is aimed at improving communication with shareholders and market participants. Routine updates of this nature generally have minimal immediate impact on stock price or business operations. Retail investors need not take any immediate action based on this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Procedural update with no direct impact on stock valuation.

headline: IZMO Limited announces its subsidiary's silicon photonics program progression with IIT Madras
hook: Phase II backed by MeitY funding
summary: IZMO Limited announced that its subsidiary, izmo Microsystems, has entered Phase II of the silicon photonics program sanctioned by MeitY, with a total outlay of Rs 99.94 crore. The project is being executed in partnership with IIT Madras. This initiative involves advanced semiconductor technology development. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap tech and semiconductor plays should note the deep-tech nature of this government-backed project.
why_it_matters: Deep-tech government project execution advances for IZMO
